profile.summary: Full-stack dev. Enjoy taking ideas 0-1 and keeping up with the latest trends in GenAI and web development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on Gavel Exec - AI contract review and drafting for lawyers.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked on Gavel Exec, a Word Add-in that redlines legal documents. Helped grow it to $350k ARR in under a year.

Previously, helped revamp our Worklows form builder and led adding PDF support to our Blueprint product, which uses LLMs to ingest a fillable PDF and create a highly customizable form in the browser for lawyers to more easily gather client data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the Blueprint team to enhance the onboarding experience for our customers.

Blueprint: https://www.gavel.io/use-cases/gavel-blueprint

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Interned with the same Live Sports team within Prime Video. Tasked with improving internal tooling that helps operators onboard and maintain third party stations. Implemented a multitude of feature requests for one of our tools and integrated the frontend with AWS CodePipeline. Implemented unit tests and configured Jest to trigger during build phase of CodePipeline to block new merges when tests fail or don’t meet coverage thresholds. Since these changes were released in early November, team has seen a significant decrease in the number of on-call pages received related to the station configuration section of the tool. Additionally, wrote integration tests for all untested APIs that dealt with the ingestion of third-party live sports editorial data.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Interned with a Live Sports team within Prime Video. Tasked with designing and implementing an internal tooling feature for Program Managers to manage sports imagery (these images make up some of the rendered images that can be seen in the Sports section of the Prime Video app). Implemented new APIs for managing images, added appropriate UI to a Live Sports internal website, and integrated an upload functionality with the existing way images were being programmatically fetched from S3. Estimated to reduce manual engineering efforts by 2-3 hours per week on average.

projects.title: Flight Predictions – predicting flights from natural language queries
projects.description:
Built two neural encoder-decoder models using PyTorch that took in natural language queries as input and generated SQL queries for the ATIS (Airline Travel Information Systems) dataset.  The output generated from querying the ATIS dataset is a list of flights corresponding to the natural language query. 

Sequence-to-sequence model (with attention): precision – 0.40 | recall – 0.40 | F1 – 0.40.  Sequence-to-sequence model (with cross-attention and self-attention): precision – 0.36 | recall – 0.36 | F1 – 0.36.

projects.title: MiniML – a small subset of an OCaml-like language
projects.description: Turing-complete language in the form of a series of interpreters for expressions of the language written in OCaml itself.  Interpreters vary in the semantics they manifest based on the substitution model, the dynamically scoped environment model, and the lexically scoped environment model.  Stub code provided from course instructor included functions for running the interpreters in a terminal and the relevant function names and parameters for the student to define.
